name: novel-studio-skill
description: OpenCreator's auditable Chinese-fiction workflow with an optional, unofficial offline Wawa submission adapter.

interface.shortDescription: File-based Chinese fiction planning, writing, and review.
interface.longDescription: Plan, draft, continue, revise, review, migrate, and package Chinese fiction with explicit reader promises, continuity state, deterministic project checks, and publication-readiness gates.
defaultPrompt: Plan a Chinese novel with a reader promise and first-volume outline.
Continue or review this novel without breaking continuity or character state.
Prepare Wawa Writer submission materials offline without logging in, uploading, or submitting.
